cohort: Fetal membranes were obtained from patients with pregnancies affected by IUGR (n = 10) and normal term pregnancies (n = 10).
finding: Increased apoptosis and consistently increased expression of the FADD protein were observed in the trophoblasts of fetal membranes from pregnancies complicated by IUGR compared with normal control pregnancies.
cross-section timing: At the time of delivery/birth, from fetal membranes of term pregnancies.
birth_weight: Nine of the ten IUGR infants had a birth weight below the 10th percentile for gestational age.
gest_age: IUGR cases were compared to normal term pregnancies, and IUGR infants had birth weights below the 10th percentile for gestational age.
